subject: ddl: Non clustered reorg duplicate  tidb rowid fix (#60132)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent with focus on reorg-partition/backfill + non-clustered _tidb_rowid handling. The change makes reorg data backfill lock old record keys and only regenerate rowids on true key-collision (existing different record), and updates partitioned-table DML (Update/Remove) plus AddRecord options to preserve/adjust _tidb_rowid across old/new partition sets during double-write. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine handling within the touched DDL/partition/table paths.
